Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam to open for Pakistan. Hasan Mahmud to start with the ball. Here we go...
... The Chase...

Pakistan just were not at their best with the ball and in the field! There were quite a few chances that went abegging and even with the ball, the lines and lengths were not upto the mark. They lacked the energy too in the field. Shah was outstanding yet again but the rest were good in patches. That last over from Wasim though can really lift Pakistan's spirits. If momentum is a thing, it is with them at the moment but now it is onto their batters. The wicket is a little slow and Pakistan will have to bat really well if they are to chase this down. Bangladesh on the other hand, have a good bowling attack. Can they defend this and end their tournament on a high?

A really good effort from Bangladesh! Yes, they will feel they have left a few more runs out there but they have got themselves to a good total. The start though was not the best as they lost two in the Powerplay but Das and Shakib batted brilliantly. They added over 80 in no time with both scoring fifties. When they were batting. 180 seemed likely. However, apart from the two, the others really struggled to time the ball and none of them could get going. Still though, Bangladesh have got themselves to a competitive score.
Two to end but that is a brilliant final over from Wasim! Just the three from it! On middle, a low full toss, this is hit wide of deep mid-wicket for two. BANGLADESH END WITH 173!
Brilliant from Wasim again! A yorker now on middle, this is jammed down to long off for one.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is a brilliant last over so far! 4 balls done and still no runs from it! This is short and outside off, Nurul Hasan looks to cut but chops it to the keeper. Afif Hossain wants a run to take strike but Rizwan picks it up and hits the stumps at his end.
Outstanding from Wasim! A yorker on off, this is jammed out back to the bowler.
A dot now! Shorter and outside off, Hasan leaves it alone thinking it would be a wide but not given. Probably gets away with one there.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the fielder! The big-hitter, Yasir Ali walks back! Shorter and on middle, this is thumped down towards long on. Nawaz takes an easy catch. Not the start Bangladesh would have wanted for the last over but just the kind of start Pakistan needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nawaz b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: Two to end! Shorter and on middle, Afif Hossain pulls it towards deep square leg and takes two. 9 from the over but the big wicket of Shakib. 10 needed to get to 180. Can they do it?
A slower one, Yasir pulls it towards short fine leg for one. A little to the left of the right and it would have been a boundary. Shah gets away with one.

OUT! TAKEN! That had the height but not the distance! A very good catch by Shadab Khan! On middle, a slower one, a back of the hand slower one. Shakib looks to heave it on the leg side but does not get the connection he would have wanted. It goes high up in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Shadab takes a good catch. End of a top knock from Shakib. He though would have loved to stay there till the end. Can Pakistan keep it below 180 now?
Commentary.Howout: c Shadab Khan b Naseem Shah

Commentary.Commentary: Just the one this time! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
WIDE! This is way too short and outside off. Left alone. Wided.
FOUR! Not the best of deliveries! On the pads, a full toss, Shah looks for the yorker but does not get it right. It is worked through square leg and it races away to the fence.
A good start to the over! A slower short ball outside off, stays low. Afif Hossain looks to pull but misses.
A dot to end! Still though, 9 from the over despite three dots in the over! This is shortish and around off, Shakib guides it towards point. He wanted a run but is sent back.
FOUR! Excellent placement again! A slower one, on the body, Shakib Al Hasan pulls it behind square on the leg side and this races away to the fence.
A dot! Shorter and on middle, Shakib looks to flat-bat it but it goes off the underedge to mid on.
FOUR! Width on offer again and it is put away! Well outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to go over cover but it goes more off the outer half over point and into the fence.
That is a good short one, very well-directed. Left alone by Shakib.
Goes short and on middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Deft! Just outstanding batting! Shorter and outside off, Shakib waits and then guides it past point for a boundary. End of a huge over for Bangladesh.
WIDE! This is well wide outside off, Shakib looks to jam it out but misses. Wided.
SIX! That is brilliant timing! Short and outside off, Shakib just waits, opens the face of the bat and carves it over point for a biggie.
Just another single! On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Fifty for Shakib! An innings where we saw both, raw power and deft touches too. He needs to stay there till the end though! A slower short ball on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, cramps the batter for room. Shakib defends.
Just wide! It could have been a run out! On middle, Afif works it to the left of the bowler and takes off. Shakib waits. He sees the ball passing Wasim and then goes for a single.
FOUR! Lovely placement! Not sure though about this very defensive bowling by Shadab! He goes wide outside off again. Shakib waits and guides it through point for a boundary.
WIDE! This is well wide outside off, left alone.
Two more! Well wide outside off, this is slapped through covers for two.
Another dot! This is well wide outside off. Shakib goes after it but it goes off the underedge back to the bowler.
Tip and run! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Another dot! On off, Afif Hossain pushes it to covers.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A dot to end! On off, Afif Hossain pushes it to covers. 11 from the over but the big wicket of Das too.

OUT! TAKEN! Mohammad Nawaz gets his revenge and Das finally has to walk back! End of an outstanding innings from him and a brilliant partnership. It has laid the foundation for Bangladesh to get to that 180-run mark. On middle, Das looks to sweep, he gets a top edge, it goes towards deep square leg where it is taken by Wasim. Can Pakistan build on this from now?
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Wasim b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Lovely shot! Das makes room and skips down the track. This is short and on off. Das slaps it over cover and bags a boundary.
Dots are gold at this stage! On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, Shakib pulls it but towards deep mid-wicket. Only one.
SIX! BANG! Shakib prefers this match up agains the left-arm spinner. He goes after him straightaway. Steps out and tonks it over the long on fence for a biggie. This could turn out to be a huge over.
A single to end another good over for Bangladesh! Shorter and on the pads, this pulled to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Lovely shot! On middle, a slower one. Shakib shapes up for the paddle scoop, he waits and then plays it over short fine leg for another boundary.
Shah gets away with one there! On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg for one.

SIX! That was almost something spectacular from Haider Ali! Wow! On the pads, this is clipped towards deep square leg. It is timed beautifull. Ali runs back, he sticks his hand up and the ball stays in but he steps on the rope as he could not stop himself in time. Indicates six immediately.
Sees Das come down the track and bangs it short and slower. Das is through the pull and he misses.
In the gap and that is two more! On middle, Das whips it wide of the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Two taken.
A dot to end! On off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Two! On middle, Das works it with soft hands towards mid-wicket. Two taken.
Another short one, this is almost head-height. Shakib looks to pull but it goes off the underedge towards square leg for one.
Shakib is going after the bowlers now! Shorter and outside off, he slashes but it goes off the underedge to cover.
FOUR! Mohammad Hasnain is leaking runs here! 100 is up for Pakistan! Shorter and on middle, ths is pulled over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Lovely shot for two! Fuller and outside off, Das lofts it over cover. Long off gets across and keeps it down to two.
Shakib shuffles across, this is fired outside off, it is hit down to long on for one.
On off, Das pushes it towards cover and takes one.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.

Quick run and that is fifty for Das! He got a few chances earlier on but it has been a solid innings from him. Really eye-catching but he needs to go on. The fifty-run stand is also up. On off, this is guided towards short third man for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Really good batting! 9 from the over with no risk being taken! On middle, this is worked between square leg and mid-wicket for a couple.
Another one! On middle, this is worked around the corner.
On the pads, Das works it with the soft hands through square leg for one.
Two more! Big pockets here so there are a lot of twos available! On middle, this is worked wide of long on for a couple.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, this is hit wide of long off for two.
Another run to finish! Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Another single! On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, Shakib slaps it through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, Das pushes it through covers for one.
Easy two! On middle, Das sweeps it through square leg for two.
Fired on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
SIX! That is a massive hit! A lovely shot! On middle, Das goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence. Bangladesh are in a really strong position here.
Flatter and on off, defended.
Two more! On middle, Das works it through mid-wicket and takes two. Das is in some pain again.
On the pads, Hasan clips it through square leg for one.
Good placement again! Fuller and on off, this is hit wide of long off for two.
Flatter and on off, this is guided through point for one.

SIX! That is a massive shot! 17 from Nawaz's first over and that is just the kind of over Bangladesh needed! Shakib steps out and gets to the pitch of it. He heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Cut away! Really nicely played! Shorter and outside off, Shakib plays it late and past point for a boundary. This should get him going.
Now takes one as this is pushed down to long on.

FOUR! Wonderful placement! Shorter and on middle, Das rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep, runs to his left and dives but to no avail. Wonderful timing, just placed it brilliantly.
Flatter and on off, Shakib pushes it to covers for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled down to long on for one.

Has that been taken? Shadab is not sure and he wants it to be checked. The umpires have taken it upstairs. NOT OUT! It is just short! On middle, Shakib pushes it back to the bowler. Shadab dives forward and looks to take it but it lands just short. Confirmed by the replays. Tidy first over by Shadab.
Shakib makes room, this is fuller and on off, it is played to covers.
Floats it up on off, this is eased down to long off for one more.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Too high! On middle, this one turns back in. Shakib looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Shakib is disappointed he did not get that away! On the pads. He looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Bangladesh are 41 for 2. Pakistan will be the happier of the two after the first 6.

Another chance goes abegging! Das survives yet again. On the pads, Shakib looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. Shakib wants a run but is sent back. Wasim underarms it towards the keeper's end but it is a wayward throw. Das wants a run now and has run almost till the other end but is sent back. Shadab from short fine leg picks the ball up and throws it to the bowler who fails to collect it.

OUT! TAKNED! Najmul Hossain Shanto walks back and Wasim gets the breakthrough his side needed. Timely one, the two were really getting a move one. Shanto though will be disappointed. That was not the best of deliveries. It was short and down the leg side. Shanto looks to help it on its way but it takes the glove and goes to Rizwan who makes no mistake. He probably tried to hit it way too hard.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! That is a superb shot! Fuller and on the pads, Shanto almost plays a scoop, he hits it well and over fine leg for a boundary.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one more.
Shorter and on middle, Shanto pulls it towards deep square leg for one.

DROPPED! That was a dolly! Shan Masood has put down a sitter! On off, Das just guides it straight into the hands of point. Masood spills it. A life for Das. This can prove costly. Pakistan and Mohammad Hasnain would have loved that wicket.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, Das looks to pull, it goes off the top edge fine on the leg side for two.

FOUR! That is glorious! Shot of the day already! Das steps out, he makes room. This is on a length. Das just shows the full face of the bat and lofts it over mid off. It bounces just inside the ropes. Another boundary. Third in the over.
FOUR! Raining boundaries now! This is short and on middle, it is thumped down the ground and to the long on fence.
Sensible stuff! Works it around the corner and takes one to follow the boundary.

FOUR! Hammered! That made a cracking sound of the bat! Shorter and angling away from off. Shanto pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence. Three boundaries in the last 7 balls. Good start to the over.
Two to end and that is a really good and a welcome big over for Bangladesh! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of the fielder at deep square leg for two.
Length and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.

That would have been close! Length and on off, Das guides it towards point and takes off. He is sent back. The fielder at point is quick to the ball, he picks it up and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Two boundaries in a row! This is a poor ball! Down the leg side. Short. Das pulls it fine on the leg side and it races away to the fence. 8 from the first two balls. Wasim under pressure.
Das looks in serious pain! Not sure what has happened to him but he seems in a lot of pain. The physio is out. He has done his job and Das is set to continue.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack, Wasim! On the pads, Das just clips it over square leg and bags the first boundary of the game. Really well timed, did not look to hit it hard at all.
A single to end another good over for Pakistan! On middle, this is pushed to mid on for one.
On off, defended.
Good footwork by Shah! On middle, this is timed beautifully back towards the bowler. Shah gets his foot down and stops it. Just the one.
Tip and run! Length and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Das has a poke at it and is beaten.

OUT! TAKEN! Pakistan draw first blood! Sarkar is looking at the toe-end of his bat as he walks back. Sarkar steps out. Shah drags his length back. It is on middle. Sarkar looks to go over mid on but this goes off the bottom and it is an easy catch for Shadab Khan there.
Commentary.Howout: c Shadab Khan b Naseem Shah

Commentary.Commentary: A single to end! Length and on off, Sarkar looks to push it on the off side. He gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.
WIDE! Short but down the leg side. Sarkar looks to pull but misses.
On off, defended.
A wild hack across the line to this length ball on off, Shanto gets an inside edge onto the pads. It goes towards point for one. He is off the mark too.
On a length again, this is guided to point.
Over the off pole! Length and on middle, this lands and moves away. Not sure why Shanto was looking to play that on the leg side. He misses and it goes over the off pole.
Three taken! Length and on off, Sarkar lofts it over cover, just uses the pace, three taken. First runs of the bat and Soumya Sarkar is off the mark.
That is a beauty! End of a brilliant first over by Shah! On middle, this one jags back in after landing. Shanto is cut into half as he looks to put bat on ball. This goes just over the middle pole.
Shorter and outside off, Shanto slashes but misses.
Just short! Fuller and on middle, Shanto plays it uppishly but it lands short of mid on.
Length again and on off, Shanto plays it to cover-point.
Good length again, Najmul Hossain Shanto plays it to covers.
Right on the money this time! On a length and around off, defended.
WIDE! Bangladesh are underway courtesy an extra! Well outside off, left alone. No carry to the keeper.

We are all set for the action to begin! The Pakistan players make their way out to the middle. They are followed by the Bangladesh openers, Soumya Sarkar and Najmul Hossain Shanto. Naseem Shah to begin. Here we go...
PAKISTAN (PLAYING XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Shan Masood, Shadab Khan, Iftikhar Ahmed, Haider Ali, Asif Ali, Mohammad Nawaz, Mohammad Wasim Jr, Naseem Shah, Mohammad Hasnain.

BANGLADESH (PLAYING XI) - Litton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan (C), Afif Hossain, Yasir Ali, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mohammad Saifuddin, Shoriful Islam, Taskin Ahmed, Hasan Mahmud.
TOSS - BANGLADESH HAVE WON THE TOSS AND OPTED TO BAT!

It is time for the final game of the group stage and it is between Pakistan and Bangladesh. This is the last chance for Bangladesh to bag a win in this tournament. They have been beaten quite easily so far but they will be wanting to end their tournament on a high. They are up against Pakistan who have blow hot and cold so far. Pakistan have been brilliant in a couple of games but have been equally poor in the other. Which side of theirs will turn up here? Will Bangladesh remain win-less or will they end with a win? Toss and teams in a bit.
